Help.Help.Title: Help
Help.About.Title: About
Help.About.Body:
DevProjex is a cross-platform open-source tool for quickly preparing project context: analyzing structure, flexibly selecting files, configuring exclusions, previewing, copying, and exporting the tree or contents. The GUI, TUI, and CLI let you work with local folders and Git repositories, creating clean context for AI assistants, code reviews, learning, and documentation.

Processing is local, and the opened project remains read-only: DevProjex does not modify source files or upload their contents to external services, and it collects no telemetry.

The source code is open for study and modification; architectural suggestions and improvements (PRs) are welcome as part of the project's development.

Stack: .NET 10 · Avalonia UI
Developer: Avazbek Olimov (Avazbek22)

Dialog.TerminalCommand.AutomaticPrompt.B:
Make the devprojex command available in terminal?

You get the interactive Terminal Workspace, direct CLI commands for scripts and CI, and a local MCP server for AI agents.

The app will add the devprojex command to PATH for your user account. After that, open a new terminal window and run devprojex to get started, or devprojex --help for a command overview.

Terminal.Tui.Welcome.HelpBody:
DEVPROJEX TERMINAL
Prepare controlled project context without leaving the terminal.

WELCOME
Open the current folder, choose a folder, clone a repository, or use Recent Workspaces for local folders and Git repositories. The list opens from saved history without network access; repository cache is checked only after selection. Open project with settings file is available from the Action Palette.

WORKSPACE
Tree controls selection. Preview shows Tree, Content, or Tree + Content in ASCII, JSON, XML, or Markdown. Parameters contains independent Content Processing, Exclusions, and File Types mini-panels. Ctrl+P opens every action, including exports and Desktop.

NAVIGATION
Up/Down or j/k moves, Enter opens, Space toggles, Tab/F6 changes panes, Shift reverses direction, / searches, and ? opens contextual Help. Esc closes one overlay or clears the current search.

OPERATIONS
Measured work shows real progress. Esc or Ctrl+C cancels active work first and keeps Terminal open. Only Exit or q on a root screen closes it.

Terminal.Tui.HelpBody:
WORKSPACE
Tree selects files and folders. Preview inspects the current context. Parameters changes Content Processing, Exclusions, and File Types in three independent mini-panels.

ACTION PALETTE
Ctrl+P lists every important action and shortcut. Type to filter, use Up/Down, then Enter. Exclusions and File Types actions focus their mini-panels. Esc restores the previous pane.

PREVIEW AND SEARCH
1/2/3 selects Tree, Content, or Tree + Content. F selects ASCII, JSON, XML, or Markdown. / filters Tree names when Tree is focused and searches the complete Preview document when Preview is focused. n/N moves between Preview matches. Esc clears the active search.

EXPORTS
E exports the context document. z exports a physical project copy to a folder; Shift+Z exports it as ZIP. A compact confirmation shows destination, counts, size, filters, and diagnostics; success appears in the status bar.

OPERATIONS
Esc or Ctrl+C cancels active work before any quit action. Recoverable errors return to the previous screen.
Terminal.Tui.Help.Tree:
PROJECT TREE
Up/Down or j/k navigates rows. Page Up/Page Down moves a page; Home/End moves to the first/last row. Left/Right collapses or expands, Enter opens a folder, and Space toggles selection. / searches the tree. : opens workspace commands. Tab/F6 moves to Preview; Shift+Tab/Shift+F6 moves to Parameters. Shift+Left/Shift+Right collapses or expands the complete tree; Ctrl+A/Ctrl+U selects all or none; R reveals a path.
Terminal.Tui.Help.Preview:
CONTEXT PREVIEW
Up/Down or j/k scrolls one line; Page Up/Page Down scrolls a page; Home/End moves to the beginning/end; Left/Right scrolls horizontally when needed. / searches the complete document, n/N selects the next/previous match, and Esc clears search. 1/2/3 changes Preview mode; F selects ASCII, JSON, XML, or Markdown. : opens workspace commands. Tab/F6 moves to Parameters; Shift+Tab/Shift+F6 returns to Tree. { and } move to the previous or next section; Ctrl+G jumps to a line; W toggles line wrapping.
Terminal.Tui.Help.Controls:
PARAMETERS
Content Processing contains five immediate transformations. Exclusions starts with All and the two mutually exclusive Git checkboxes. File Types has its own All control. Up/Down or j/k moves inside a mini-panel and crosses to the next one at a boundary; Enter or Space toggles a row. Each long list scrolls independently. : opens workspace commands, Ctrl+P opens actions, E exports context, z exports a folder, and Shift+Z exports ZIP. Tab/F6 returns to Tree; Shift+Tab/Shift+F6 moves to Preview.
